motivation: s27 audit on T0/T1/T7 (dev): rule+cause misattributes 313 force_below_band failures -- the cause rule raises the closure stop, but the measured hold does not rise with it (gripper plateaus).

repair_v2_resp.candidates: untried (force, s0) with closure stop lo <= band hi (v1 manner bound); for slip_or_drop also (f0, slower speed inside the speed band) as in v1
repair_v2_resp.prediction: library rows via the same backoff as Library._sel (obj+cfg -> obj+force -> any_obj+cfg); predicted interval = mean hold_min / mean hold_max of stable rows; a candidate with rows but no stable row is predicted to slip
repair_v2_resp.order: 1) known and predicted inside the force band (and stable), nearest band centre first; 2) unknown candidates in the v1 cause direction (v1 order); known-but-predicted-outside candidates are dropped

dev_vs_heldout: T0/T1/T7 step25 grid = development (the misattribution was observed there); T6 step28 grid = held-out, evaluated once, not tuned
metrics: first pass, pass within budget 3, failed attempts, honest stops on unsatisfiable, false stops on satisfiable, cost; per cause: repair success after a force_below_band failure
